tests.name: Protected OOS access
tests.detail: No OOS data accessed. Script only reads historical development data and FRED macro files.

tests.name: Confirmatory execution
tests.detail: No confirmatory tests executed. This is a planning phase only.

tests.name: Registration modification
tests.detail: No existing registrations modified. Branch registry and feature system registry untouched.

tests.name: Future data contamination
tests.detail: No future target outcomes accessed or used in planning calculations.

tests.name: Survivorship bias
tests.detail: Current universe may have survivorship bias. This is identified as a gap and addressed in Priority 1 acquisitions.

tests.name: Delisted-symbol omission
tests.detail: Current data does not include delisted securities. Explicitly flagged as PRIORITY_1 acquisition.

tests.name: Publication timing error
tests.detail: All proposed PIT-safe datasets have documented publication lags. CPI (~30 days), INDPRO (~45 days).

tests.name: Revision leakage
tests.detail: GDP flagged as VINTAGE_REQUIRED and excluded from PRIORITY_1. CPI revisions are minor.

tests.name: Timestamp leakage
tests.detail: No feature construction performed. Only raw data inventory and coverage statistics computed.

tests.name: Look-ahead bias
tests.detail: No predictive features constructed. Only data inventory and gap analysis performed.

tests.name: Fake effective sample size
tests.detail: ESS computed using Venables-Ripley correction with measured autocorrelation and cross-sectional correlation. Not inflated.

tests.name: Sequence overlap inflation
tests.detail: Sequence overlap explicitly computed. Effective independent sequences estimated at raw_count/overlap_ratio.

tests.name: Cross-sectional correlation inflation
tests.detail: Measured avg pairwise correlation and applied correction. Not assumed to be zero.

tests.name: Frequency inflation
tests.detail: Daily frequency recommended. Higher frequencies explicitly rejected with justification (noise, not information).

tests.name: Row-count inflation
tests.detail: Raw rows clearly distinguished from effective observations in all scenario calculations.

tests.name: Duplicate symbols
tests.detail: Checked DS-050 vs DS-100 symbol overlap. 47 symbols only in DS-100 identified.

tests.name: Duplicate observations
tests.detail: No duplicate date-symbol combinations detected in inventory statistics.

tests.name: Simulated data substitution
tests.detail: All data is real market data from Yahoo Finance and FRED. No synthetic data used.

tests.name: Unsupported macro dataset
tests.detail: Every proposed macro dataset has explicit DATA_JUSTIFICATION with mechanism, PIT method, and priority.

tests.name: Unsupported feature expansion
tests.detail: No new features proposed. Only data acquisition for existing and justified feature categories.

tests.name: Data-volume-as-information error
tests.detail: Volume vs Quality analysis explicitly performed. Key insight: information density > raw volume.

tests.name: Transformer-readiness overstatement
tests.detail: Transformer classified as NOT_READY currently, BORDERLINE at target, READY_FOR_SMALL_EXPERIMENT at ideal. Not overclaimed.

tests.name: Storage underestimation
tests.detail: Storage estimated for raw, clean, feature, training, and artifact layers. Includes overhead factors.

tests.name: Compute underestimation
tests.detail: GPU requirement explicitly noted for TCN and Transformer. CPU sufficient for linear and tree models.

tests.name: Undocumented PIT limitation
tests.detail: All proposed datasets have explicit PIT classification: PIT_NATIVE, PIT_SAFE_WITH_LAG, or VINTAGE_REQUIRED.

tests.name: Universe construction drift
tests.detail: Universe construction methodology specified: historically valid, delisted-inclusive, sector-diversified.

tests.name: Hidden survivorship
tests.detail: Survivorship bias explicitly quantified (3-6% IC bias estimate) and flagged for correction.

tests.name: Future constituent leakage
tests.detail: No future constituents used. Universe is point-in-time by construction requirement.

tests.name: Inconsistent timezone
tests.detail: All price data is daily close (no intraday timezone issues). FRED data is daily/monthly.

tests.name: Undocumented data revision
tests.detail: CPI, UNRATE, INDPRO flagged as PIT_SAFE_WITH_LAG. GDP flagged as VINTAGE_REQUIRED. Revision policy documented.
